slides.title: Write the thing *you won't say.*
slides.sub: Nobody has to read it. That's the point.

slides.title: Find the sentence
slides.body: Most of us carry one: the thing we haven't admitted to anyone, sometimes not even to ourselves. You may already know yours.

slides.title: Write it plainly
slides.body: One page, no audience. Write it the way you'd never say it out loud. Skip the softening and the explaining.

slides.title: Read it back once
slides.body: Ask: is this true? What have I been doing to avoid it? Notice what shifts when it's on paper instead of in your head.

slides.title: Keep it, or let it go
slides.body: You don't have to act on it today. Keep the page or tear it up. Just let it be said once, honestly.
